page.overview:
Who is Kai?

is a half-elven teenage rogue and one of the campers attending Wildemount Wildlings. He is played by Aleks Le.

Kai is a young boy of wood elf ancestry, with white hair, blue eyes, a golden earring in his right ear, and a necklace with a blue crystal. He is 5′ 9″ tall.

He is a very "chill" and fun person, rather carefree, although with troublemaker tendencies.

Kai was born in 828 PD; he became an orphan and was raised by bandits. That led to his eventual problems with the justice, which caused him to be sent to the Wildemount Wildlings camp in 844 PD, as part of a court-order rehabilitation plan. He didn't make much progress gaining badges or improving himself, but he took an interest in Padmund Pondhop's project of creating a Mighty Nein-themed card game, so he helped him with that, becoming the illustrator of the project.
